out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Lighting Intensity, 50 Foot Candles Minimum
violations.observation: Observed that inadequate lighting was provided in the food preparation areas. Several light on the ceiling are burnout.
violations.corrective_action: Increase the lighting to provide a minimum of 50 foot candles in all food preparation areas. Replace the burnout bulbs to provide adequate illumination in the food preparation areas.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed unmarked spray bottles containing cleaning chemical solutions , without labels to identify contents.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: sauces in unmarked squeeze bottles noted at the salad station.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: unmarked containers and squeeze bottles containing hard-to identify foods were labeled to identify contents.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. Containers and bottles were labeled during the inspection.
